decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Revolving objective turret with three separate objectives, rack-and-pinion focus wheels, stage clips, sub-stage condenser and tilting mirror are all resolved as distinct parts. Brass, black enamel and ground glass read as three convincing materials in every orbit. Top and bottom views confirm a properly closed cast base. 20.6k tris.
limitations: Optics are opaque in the inspection render; enable transmission for the eyepiece and mirror.
Focus and turret are modelled in fixed positions with no rig.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Four curved blades, motor housing with cooling fins, downrod, ceiling canopy and a frosted light diffuser are distinct parts. The top and bottom views confirm correct blade pitch and a closed motor underside. Brushed metal and matte black read as separate materials. 16.4k tris.
limitations: Blades are not rigged to spin; animate the blade parent object yourself.
Light diffuser is opaque in the inspection render and emits nothing.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Hexagonal brass body with star-cut ventilation holes, confirmed in the top view, a domed cap, hanging chain and a properly closed base in the bottom view. The 4 is for materials: the six glass panels render as flat pure black with no transmission or interior detail, so they read as holes rather than glazing.
limitations: Glass panels are flat black in the inspection render and need transmission plus an interior light.
Long suspension chain makes the lantern small in whole-object framing.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Tubular headboard and footboard with vertical spindles, side rails, cast joint collars and a full wire-spring mattress deck, all visible in the top and bottom views. Chipped white paint over rust tracks the tubes believably. The 4 is for topology: 50k triangles, most of it in the spring grid.
limitations: 50k triangles, largely the wire spring deck; replace with a plane if it will be covered by a mattress.
Frame only: no mattress or bedding included.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Stackable tote with two hinged split lids shown open, ribbed lid panels, moulded hand grips and a genuinely hollow interior with correct wall thickness, confirmed in the top view. Scuffed blue plastic with grime concentrated at the base reads consistently all round. 7.1k tris.
limitations: Lids are modelled open; rotate the lid objects to close them.
A generic shipping label with a barcode is visible on the front face.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Shouldered vase on a splayed foot with three bands of engraved scrollwork carried in both geometry and normal map. The top view shows a real hollow neck and interior, and the bottom view a closed foot. Engraving stays registered around the full orbit with no UV seam. Just 2.6k tris.
limitations: Interior is dark below the neck, so top-down cameras see a black cavity.
Polished brass will look flat without an environment map.
